question: How many types of igneous rocks are there?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Two.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Igneous rock** can form either beneath the **surface as intrusive rocks or on the surface as extrusive (volcanic) rocks, with or without crystallisation. **
 
• This magma can come from partial melts of existing rocks in the mantle or crust of a planet. 
 
• One or more of three procedures can manufacture melting: **an increase in temperature, a drop in pressure, or a change in composition**.
 
• Their are two types of igneous rocks:** extrusive and intrusive rocks ****​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Types of rocks are intrusive igneous rocks and extrusive igneous rocks 
 
 
• **Intrusive igneous rocks** are** crystallize beneath the earth’s surface resulting in large crystals as the cooling takes place steadily. **
 
• **Diorite, granite, pegmatite** are intrusive igneous rocks.
 
• **Extrusive igneous rocks break out onto the surface developing in tiny crystals as the cooling takes place very fast. **
 
• **Basalt, tuff, pumice** are extrusive igneous rocks.
 
 
 
• **​Examples **of extrusive igneous rocks are
 
 
• Mica
 
• Quartz
 
• Basalt
